summary: amazon.aws also gained iam_password_policy, iam_role, iam_role_info, s3_bucket_info and sts_assume_role migrated from community.aws.
questions: Should iam_role_info tasks use amazon.aws now?

answer_card.title: Modules migrated into amazon.aws (2)
answer_card.answer_md:
These modules moved from **community.aws** to **amazon.aws**. Update FQCNs in your playbooks:

- `iam_password_policy`
- `iam_role`, `iam_role_info`
- `s3_bucket_info`
- `sts_assume_role`
